meta.name: copywriting
meta.description: Cold email copywriting frameworks, principles, and sequence structure. Use when the user asks about email copywriting frameworks, cold email writing rules, email sequence structure, email variations, e-commerce cold email, copy testing, A/B testing email copy, or needs named frameworks (Do the Math, Short Trigger, Pattern Interrupt, etc.). Triggers on "copywriting framework", "email framework", "Do the Math", "Short Trigger", "Pattern Interrupt", "email variations", "email structure", "copy principles", "e-com cold email", "ecommerce outreach", "email copy rules", "how to write cold email", "copy testing". Do NOT use for personalization at scale (use personalization) or subject lines only (use subject-lines).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出高转化率的冷邮件文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在为冷邮件转化率发愁，需要高效文案框架。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're struggling with cold email conversion rates and need effective copy frameworks.

howto.what: 当你问关于冷邮件写作时，Claude 会根据13种命名框架（如 Do the Math）和核心原则，帮你写出高效邮件，并规划邮件序列结构。
howto.when: 当你询问冷邮件框架、规则、序列结构，或提到“Do the Math”“Short Trigger”等关键词，或要求写电商冷邮件时触发。

say.text: 请用'Do the Math'框架给CFO写一封冷邮件。
say.note: Claude会计算具体节省金额并生成邮件。

say.text: 帮我设计一个三封邮件的序列结构。
say.note: Claude会给出邮件1、2、3的变体和时机。

say.text: 我卖给电商品牌，帮我写冷邮件。
say.note: Claude会使用电商专用模板和轻松语气。

howto.what_en: Helps you write effective cold emails using 13 named frameworks (e.g., Do the Math) and core principles, and plan email sequence structure.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about cold email frameworks, rules, sequence structure, mention keywords like "Do the Math" or "Short Trigger", or need e-commerce cold emails.

say_en.text: Write a cold email to a CFO using the 'Do the Math' framework.
say_en.note: Claude calculates savings and drafts the email.

say_en.text: Design a 3-email sequence structure for me.
say_en.note: Claude provides variations and timing for each email.

say_en.text: Help me write cold emails for e-commerce brands.
say_en.note: Claude uses e-commerce playbook with casual tone.
